title: Will the index fit and still fill a filtered result set?
description: Change rows, dimensions, storage, candidate breadth, filter selectivity, and top-k. Exact payload math is separated from benchmark-dependent index size and recall assumptions.

indexes.label: Exact sequential search
indexes.detail: Perfect nearest-neighbor recall with no ANN index; work grows with the eligible row set.

indexes.label: HNSW benchmark profile
indexes.detail: Stronger speed-recall trade-off with higher memory, build, insert, and maintenance cost.

indexes.label: IVFFlat benchmark profile
indexes.detail: Lower-memory lists trained from representative table data; probes control query work.
